name: Connecting Ridge / Site 001
source: Boazman et al., Planetary Science Journal (2022); Site 001 89.45 S, 137.31 W
note: Representative published point, not an approved landing zone
context: One of NASA's 13 Artemis III candidate regions in 2022 (Connecting Ridge); not on the 2024 shortlist of nine.

name: Shackleton Rim / Site 004
source: Boazman et al., Planetary Science Journal (2022); Site 004 89.78 S, 155.73 W
note: Representative published point, not an approved landing zone
context: Study site on the rim of Shackleton crater, from Boazman et al. (2022). Its published point sits in a small hollow.

name: Shackleton crest / near Site 004
source: Our choice: highest 5 m LOLA cell within 100 m of Site 004 (Boazman et al. 2022), found with Terrain/scripts/find_crest.py
note: Team-chosen comparison point, not a published or approved site
representative_point_note: Added by our team: the highest 5 m LOLA cell within 100 m of Site 004's published point, 54 m away and 10.5 m higher. The published point sits in a hollow where nearby ground blocks the Sun and Earth in every direction; this crest shows how much 54 m can change. Not a published site.
context: A crest 54 m from Shackleton Rim's published point, added to show how much a few tens of metres matter.

name: Malapert Massif / MMA_K2023
source: Wueller et al., Journal of Geophysical Research: Planets (2026), Table A1
note: Representative research site, not an approved landing zone
context: Malapert Massif is on NASA's Artemis III candidate-region lists in both 2022 and 2024.
